eventMetadata.context_description: Current forecasts from PAGASA place Manila’s June 5 high near 32 °C under the southwest monsoon, with 70–100 % rain chances and high humidity that caps daytime peaks through reduced solar heating and evaporative cooling. This scientific setup—typical early-rainy-season convection and cloud cover—explains why traders cluster tightly around 31–32 °C while assigning lower weight to 33 °C or higher; occasional breaks in cloudiness or stronger urban heat-island effects could nudge readings upward, yet model consensus favors modest maxima near the seasonal norm of 31–32 °C.
